definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. definitions.description: Linear List Comments
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.description: Linear Get Cycle
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.description: Linear List Cycles
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. definitions.name: Linear Get Organization
definitions.description: Linear Get Organization
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.name: Linear Search Issues
definitions.description: Linear Search Issues
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static query document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.description: Linear Create Issue
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static mutation document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="LINEAR CREATE-ISSUE". $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.description: Linear Update Issue
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static mutation document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="LINEAR UPDATE-ISSUE". $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.name: Linear Create Project
definitions.description: Linear Create Project
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static mutation document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="LINEAR CREATE-PROJECT". $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. definitions.name: Linear Update Project
definitions.description: Linear Update Project
definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static mutation document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="LINEAR UPDATE-PROJECT". $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted. Sources: https://linear.app/developers/graphql https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linear/linear/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql https://linear.app/developers/pagination https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting

definitions.documentation: Fixed POST https://api.linear.app/graphql with a static mutation document and typed variables. External credentials only: authMode=apiKey (default) selects RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey or LINEAR_API_KEY with raw Authorization; authMode=oauth selects credentials.accessToken or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN with Bearer. RuntimeConnection.config is merged with node config; built-in config.$connection selects the profile; tokenSecret explicitly overrides. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="LINEAR CREATE-RELATION". $retries must be zero. One dispatch; no arbitrary GraphQL, OAuth exchange/refresh, pagination, retry or replay. Results preserve data/null/falsy values and exact date/ID strings, with hasErrors/partial and sanitized error paths; private messages/extensions are discarded. Provider mutation success=false remains false and partial mutation data never proves completion. Pages expose nodes/edges/pageInfo; returned cursors require explicit caller follow-up. Attachment URL and iconUrl are provider metadata only, never downloaded. Bounded at 100 rows/page, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values and 16384 nonempty chunks. Strict UTF8/UTF16; Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch/read/decode/final cleanup. Fractional/unsafe response numeric tokens become exact decimal strings. Cycle creation is unsupported in the current official schema and intentionally omitted.
